Q: Beam quality of the user's beam

D_air: Dose to the air in the cavity
D_wQ: Dose to water in the user's beam
N_Dw: Calibration coefficient in dose to water (from ⁶⁰Co)
N_DwQ0: Calibration coefficient in dose to water, measured in ⁶⁰Co
Q_0: Beam quality of the calibration: ⁶⁰Co
Q_sat: Saturation charge: all the charge freed
R_p: Practical range of the protons (here the PSTAR CSDA range)
R_res: Residual range at the reference depth
W_air: Mean energy spent per ion pair formed in air
a_0: Two voltage coefficient for pulsed beams (TRS-398)
a_1: Two voltage coefficient for pulsed beams (TRS-398)
a_2: Two voltage coefficient for pulsed beams (TRS-398)
f: Fraction of the freed charge that is collected
k_Q: Beam quality factor from ⁶⁰Co to the user's beam
k_QQ0: Beam quality factor from ⁶⁰Co to the user's beam
k_TP: Air density correction for temperature and pressure
m: Mass of the air in the cavity
n_0: Ion pairs freed per unit volume by one pulse
p_Q: Perturbation factor of the chamber in the beam
p_Q0: Perturbation factor of the chamber in ⁶⁰Co
s_wair: Ratio of the mass stopping powers of water and air
u: Boag's recombination parameter, α n₀ d²/((k₁ + k₂)V)
